Common headers 8

Standard Clash headers. If you already send them, ReClash picks them up unchanged.

subscription-userinfoCommonShows traffic usage and the expiry date.
Formatupload=<bytes>; download=<bytes>; total=<bytes>; expire=<unix-seconds>
Traffic usage and quota in bytes, plus the expiry as unix-seconds. total=0 means unlimited, expire=0 perpetual. The client shows the remaining amount, a usage bar and days left.
Subscription-Userinfo: upload=13421772800; download=83994443776; total=214748364800; expire=1798761600
profile-titleCommonNames the imported profile unless the user has renamed it. Use base64: for non-ASCII text.
FormatProfile name, plain UTF-8 or Base64
Names the imported profile unless the user has renamed it. Use base64: for non-ASCII text.
Profile-Title: Nebula VPN
Profile-Title: base64:0J3QtdCx0YPQu9CwIFZQTg==
content-dispositionCommonUsed as a profile-name fallback.
FormatA response filename
Used as a profile-name fallback.
Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="nebula.yaml"
profile-update-intervalCommonSets the profile update interval.
FormatPositive integer, in hours
Sets the profile update interval.
Profile-Update-Interval: 24
support-urlCommonAdds a support action. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
FormatProvider support URL
Adds a support action. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
Support-Url: https://nebula.example/help
announceCommonShows a provider announcement.
FormatPlain text or Base64
Shows a provider announcement.
Announce: base64:0J/RgNC+0YTQuNC70LDQutGC0LjQutCw
report-urlCommonCompatibility name for reclash-reporturl. Adds a “report an issue” action for the subscription.
FormatIssue-report URL
Compatibility name for reclash-reporturl. Adds a “report an issue” action for the subscription.
profile-web-page-urlCommonCompatibility name for reclash-webpageurl, already emitted by marzban and 3x-ui.
FormatProvider account URL
Compatibility name for reclash-webpageurl, already emitted by marzban and 3x-ui.

ReClash headers 24

Headers only ReClash understands. Every one is optional.

reclash-announceReClashProvider announcement. Takes priority over announce.
FormatPlain text or Base64
Provider announcement. Takes priority over announce.
ReClash-Announce: base64:0J/RgNC+0YTQuNC70LDQutGC0LjQutCw 14.04
reclash-announceurlReClashTurns the announcement into a link: opens instead of the dismiss button on the announcement sheet and card. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
FormatProvider announcement URL
Turns the announcement into a link: opens instead of the dismiss button on the announcement sheet and card. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
ReClash-AnnounceURL: https://nebula.example/news
reclash-supporturlReClashflclashx-supporturlSupport page. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
FormatProvider support URL
Aliasflclashx-supporturl
Support page. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
ReClash-SupportURL: https://nebula.example/help
reclash-autoupdateintervalReClashflclashx-autoupdateintervalProfile update interval.
FormatPositive integer, in minutes
Aliasflclashx-autoupdateinterval
Profile update interval.
ReClash-AutoUpdateInterval: 60
reclash-expiredaysReClashDays-before-expiry the client reminds at. Overrides the default 3,2,1.
FormatComma-separated days
Days-before-expiry the client reminds at. Overrides the default 3,2,1.
ReClash-ExpireDays: 7,3,1
reclash-trafficpercentReClashUsed-traffic percents the client reminds at on metered plans. Overrides the default 90.
FormatComma-separated percents
Used-traffic percents the client reminds at on metered plans. Overrides the default 90.
ReClash-TrafficPercent: 80,95
reclash-servicenameReClashflclashx-servicenameProvider name shown in the dashboard.
FormatPlain text or Base64
Aliasflclashx-servicename
Provider name shown in the dashboard.
ReClash-ServiceName: Nebula VPN
reclash-activetextReClashThe caption under the hero orb and in the Android notification, in place of “You are protected”.
FormatPlain text or Base64
The caption under the connection ring and in the Android notification — in place of the default “You are protected”. Use base64: for non-ASCII.
ReClash-ActiveText: Nebula has you covered
reclash-servicelogoReClashflclashx-servicelogoProvider logo shown in the dashboard and connection control.
FormatAbsolute HTTPS image URL
Aliasflclashx-servicelogo
The logo on the dashboard and connection control. An absolute HTTPS URL, PNG or SVG, square 256–512 px, transparent background; keep the meaningful part inside the central 80 % — edges get rounded off.
ReClash-ServiceLogo: https://nebula.example/logo-512.png
reclash-serverinfoReClashflclashx-serverinfoGroup used to resolve the active server shown in the dashboard.
FormatProxy-group name, plain text or Base64
Aliasflclashx-serverinfo
Group used to resolve the active server shown in the dashboard.
ReClash-ServerInfo: Auto
reclash-buyplanReClashflclashx-buyplanSubscription renewal or plan purchase action.
FormatURL
Aliasflclashx-buyplan
Subscription renewal or plan purchase action.
ReClash-BuyPlan: https://nebula.example/billing
reclash-buytrafficReClashflclashx-buytrafficExtra-traffic purchase action.
FormatURL
Aliasflclashx-buytraffic
Extra-traffic purchase action.
ReClash-BuyTraffic: https://nebula.example/billing/traffic
reclash-reporturlReClashSubscription issue-report action.
FormatURL
Subscription issue-report action.
reclash-webpageurlReClashPersonal-account link in the subscription details. Also read from the Profile-Web-Page-Url header that marzban and 3x-ui already emit. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
FormatProvider account URL
Personal-account link in the subscription details. Also read from the Profile-Web-Page-Url header that marzban and 3x-ui already emit. Use an absolute HTTPS URL.
ReClash-WebPageURL: https://nebula.example/account
reclash-viewReClashflclashx-viewSuggests the proxy-page presentation for this profile.
Formattype:… sort:… layout:… icon:… card:…
Aliasflclashx-view
Tokens of the form key:value, comma- or semicolon-separated. Unknown keys and values are dropped, the rest apply. It is a suggestion, not an order: the user can switch the view back.
KeyValuesWhat it sets
typetab listProxy page shape
sortdefault none delay nameNode sorting
layoutloose standard tightGrid density
iconnone standard iconNode icons
cardexpand shrink min onelineCard size
ReClash-View: type:tab; sort:delay; layout:tight; icon:standard; card:shrink
reclash-hexReClashflclashx-hexApplies a theme while this profile is active.
FormatRRGGBB[:variant][:pureblack]
Aliasflclashx-hex
An RRGGBB or AARRGGBB colour, then an optional palette variant and an optional pureblack (an AMOLED black background). Separators are :, ; or ,. The theme applies while the profile is active.
VariantWhat it does
tonalspotBalanced, the default
fidelityCloser to the source colour
monochromeGreyscale
neutralNearly desaturated
vibrantMaximum saturation
expressiveShifted hue
contentContent-driven, livelier than fidelity
ReClash-Hex: 2FD3B6
ReClash-Hex: 2FD3B6:vibrant
ReClash-Hex: FF7C5CFF;expressive;pureblack
reclash-backgroundReClashflclashx-backgroundApplies a dashboard background while this profile is active.
Formaturl[,opacity]
Aliasflclashx-background
An absolute http or https image URL and an optional opacity from 1 to 100. The default is 10 — a background should stay a background. Applies while the profile is active.
ReClash-Background: https://nebula.example/bg.webp,14
reclash-heroringReClashSets the connected-state hero-ring gradient.
Formatc1;c2;c3
Exactly three colours — the gradient of the ring around the connect button. Fewer or more than three values are ignored entirely. This header has no alias.
ReClash-HeroRing: 7C5CFF;3686ED;2FD3B6
reclash-heroeffectReClashA living effect behind the connection ring. Only aurora is supported for now; any other value turns the effect off.
Formataurora
A living effect behind the connection ring. Only aurora — a soft aurora glow — is supported for now; any other value turns the effect off. This header has no alias.
ReClash-HeroEffect: aurora
reclash-widgetsReClashSuggests dashboard widgets and their order.
Formatcomma-separated names
Comma-separated widget names — their order becomes the order on the dashboard. Widgets unavailable on a platform simply do not appear. reclash-custom controls how the list merges with the user's own.
NameWidgetAvailable on
networkSpeedNetwork speedall platforms
trafficUsageTraffic usageall platforms
networkDetectionNetwork detectionall platforms
connectionPathConnection pathall platforms
tunButtonTUN buttonWindows, macOS, Linux
vpnButtonVPN buttonAndroid
systemProxyButtonSystem proxyWindows, macOS, Linux
intranetIpIntranet IPall platforms
memoryInfoMemory infoall platforms
goroutineInfoGoroutinesall platforms
metaInfoSubscription: term and quotaall platforms
announceAnnouncementall platforms
serviceInfoService cardall platforms
changeServerButtonChange serverall platforms
smartRoutingSmart routingall platforms
serviceStatusService statusall platforms
connectionsConnectionsall platforms
dnsQueriesDNS queriesall platforms
requestsRequestsall platforms
runTimeStartall platforms
proxyGroupsProxy groupall platforms
profilesProfilesall platforms
overrideDnsButtonOverride DNSall platforms
ReClash-Widgets: serviceInfo,networkSpeed,trafficUsage,changeServerButton
reclash-customReClashControls how reclash-widgets is merged.
Formatadd | update
How reclash-widgets merges with the set the user already assembled: add appends the missing widgets, update replaces the whole set. Without this header the set is suggested only when the profile is first added.
ReClash-Widgets: serviceInfo,networkSpeed,trafficUsage,changeServerButton
ReClash-Custom: update
reclash-settingsReClashApplication defaults offered when the profile is first added — applied only after the user confirms.
Formatcomma-separated tokens
Application defaults. Offered once — when the profile is first added: ReClash shows the requested changes and applies them only after the user confirms. Unlisted settings keep their values; after that the settings belong to the user.
TokenWhat it turns on
minimizeMinimize instead of exiting
autorunStart the connection when ReClash opens
shadowstartLaunch in the background
autostartLaunch at OS startup
autoupdateCheck for ReClash updates
openlogsOpen logs with the connection
closeconnectionsClose connections when the VPN pauses
ReClash-Settings: minimize,autoupdate
reclash-newdomainReClashflclashx-newdomainProposes a subscription-domain migration subject to checks.
Formathost[:port]
Aliasflclashx-newdomain
A hostname and an optional port only — no scheme, path or query. The client does not switch blindly: it verifies that the new address really serves your subscription, and only then migrates the profile.
ReClash-NewDomain: sub.nebula.example
ReClash-NewDomain: sub.nebula.example:8443
reclash-fallbackhostsReClashSupplies fallback hosts for transient fetch failures.
Formatup to 4 comma-separated hosts
Up to four comma-separated hostnames — no ports, no scheme. Names are lowercased, duplicates removed, the excess dropped. The client falls back to them when the main address is temporarily unreachable. No alias.
ReClash-FallbackHosts: sub2.nebula.example,sub3.nebula.example
